edition.authority: Second Vatican Council; Pope Paul VI
edition.notes: The official Latin Acta constituent contains numbered articles 1-5 on printed pp. 740-744, followed on p. 744 by the promulgation formula, date, papal signature, and a cross-reference to the common subscriptions printed on pp. 696-701. Those separately printed shared subscriptions are not part of this constituent segment.
edition.title: Declaratio de Ecclesiae Habitudine ad Religiones Non-Christianas Nostra aetate

passages.context: The Declaration's complete numbered Latin body, beginning with article 1 on printed p. 740 and ending with article 5 on printed p. 744 immediately before the promulgation formula.
passages.notes: The beginning, numbered sequence, article-5 endpoint, and transition to promulgation were checked against the exact Acta artifact. The passage does not include the promulgation formula or the shared subscriptions referenced on p. 744, and no complete diplomatic transcription or word-for-word image collation is claimed.

work.author: Second Vatican Council
work.description: The Second Vatican Council's Declaration on the Relation of the Church to Non-Christian Religions, solemnly promulgated by Pope Paul VI on 28 October 1965. Its numbered articles 1-5 address humanity's common origin and end, the Church's relation to non-Christian religions, Muslims, the Jewish people, antisemitism, and discrimination.
work.title: Nostra aetate
